policy: A rule is VERIFIED only when an OFFICIAL marketplace page states it, the page is named by https URL, and the date it was read is recorded. A value from a blog, a forum answer or a service provider is a hint, never a rule: it carries value null here. Nothing in this file is copied into format_constraint unless every field a constraint row needs is OFFICIAL_VERIFIED for one marketplace and scope (see slim_cmo.marketplace_rules.promotable_row).

statuses.OFFICIAL_VERIFIED: stated on an official marketplace page that was read on checked_on; complete and current for the scope
statuses.OFFICIAL_PARTIAL: stated on an official page, but for part of the scope only (for example 'most categories') or possibly superseded; never promoted
statuses.THIRD_PARTY_ONLY: only secondary sources were found; the figure is kept as a hint in `hint`, `value` is null
statuses.NOT_FOUND: no source could be read (official help is behind the seller login, or nothing was found)

source.title: New product title requirements effective from January 21, 2025

rules.note: The announcement says titles may not exceed 200 characters including spaces for MOST categories and sends readers to the 'Product title requirements' help page for category and store limits, which is behind the seller login and could not be read. A third-party blog reports a later, lower limit (75 characters from July 2026); no Amazon page I could read confirms or denies it. Not promoted.
